Fabulosity Bike Ride

Washington, DC · Social

Fabulosity Bike Ride is a social group ride in Washington, DC. It rolls third Saturday of the month at 10:00 am from National Museum of African American History and Culture.

Next ride Sat, Oct 17, 10:00 AM EDT

How we know

The group's Meetup feed lists a Fabulosity Bike Ride on the third Saturday at 10:00 am: Oct 17, Nov 21 and Dec 19, 2026, then monthly through July 2027, all from the museum (feed fetched Oct 1, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Fabulosity Bike Ride group ride

A small monthly social ride around the nation's capital. The group describes it as relaxing rides and a chance to build community. Meets at the National Museum of African American History and Culture on Constitution Ave.
